description.7.0: Set attachment conditions for the specified link directions. The current attachment condition will be replaced by the condition specified here. Conditions are specified in keyword pairs, the first (keyword) being the degree-of-freedom and the second ([linkattachblock]) being the type of condition to use. The following keywords are available to specify the degree-of-freedom:
description.9.0: Set attachment conditions for the specified link directions. The current attachment condition will be replaced by the condition specified here. Conditions are specified in keyword pairs, the first ( keyword ) being the degree-of-freedom and the second ( [linkattachblock] ) being the type of condition to use. notes: '[linkattachblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (free, linear, normal-yield, pile-yield, rigid, shear-yield).

description.7.0: pile yield spring. This is only available in the \(x\) or \(y\) translational degrees-of-freedom, and the dependent model is automatically installed in \(y\) or \(z\), respectively.
